title: Can NLP Tackle Hate Speech in the Real World? Stakeholder-Informed Feedback and Survey on Counterspeech

bias_targets.methodology: Participatory case study conducting structured interactive focus groups and collaborative practical activities with five NGOs specializing in online Gender-Based Violence (oGBV) to evaluate appropriate counterspeech responses to real-world misogynistic hate speech samples.

Systematic literature review of 74 NLP publications to assess how hate speech and counterspeech datasets are created, specifically evaluating the extent of stakeholder participation and the inclusion of target demographic metadata.
